en-US.releaseNotes:
## 🔐 Security update 🛡️

Trivy v0.76.2 bundles several security fixes:

• Official container images are rebuilt on Alpine 3.24.3, which fixes `musl`/`musl-utils` (CVE-2026-107891), and the build picks up fixed `libcurl` (24 CVEs, including HIGH CVE-2026-92392) and `brotli-libs` (CVE-2026-111497) from the `v3.24` package repository.
• `golang.org/x/net` is bumped to v0.62.0, fixing two vulnerabilities in `golang.org/x/net/html`：CVE-2026-78661 (quadratic complexity when coalescing text nodes) and CVE-2026-97045 (missing ancestor namespace check when rendering raw text).
• `github.com/go-jose/go-jose/v4` is bumped to v4.1.6, fixing [GHSA-mgcc-cww5-fp2q](https://github.com/go-jose/go-jose/security/advisories/GHSA-mgcc-cww5-fp2q).

We recommend upgrading to v0.76.2 and redeploying container images to apply these updates.
